mapper.select: SELECT * FROM RESERVATION ORDER BY reservationId ASC
SELECT * FROM STUDYROOMS ORDER BY roomId ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( userId, trackId, roomId, reservationDate, startTime, endTime, participantCount, purpose, status, createdAt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{trackId}, #{roomId}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{participantCount}, #{purpose}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT roomId FROM STUDYROOMS WHERE roomName = #{roomName}

SELECT * FROM RESERVATION WHERE reservationDate >= CURDATE() AND reservationDate <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (status = 'ACTIVE' OR status = 'active' OR status = 'COMPLETED' OR status = 'completed') ORDER BY reservationDate ASC, startTime ASC
